channel.title: Ayush Singh (SinghCod3r) — Technical Engineering Dispatches
channel.description: Technical articles and engineering dispatches on Linux systems engineering, OpenPrinting printer driver architecture, and AI agent containment by Ayush Singh.

item.title: AI Agents Are Getting More Powerful. The Next Big Problem Is Containing Them
item.dc:creator: Ayush Singh
item.description: For years, we asked AI to write code. Now we are asking AI to run code. That difference is much bigger than it sounds. A coding assistant that suggests a function is one thing. An autonomous agent with terminal and repo access requires strict sandboxing and least-privilege architecture.

item.title: I Almost Quit Open Source After GSoC 2026 — Then system-config-printer Changed Everything
item.dc:creator: Ayush Singh
item.description: How learning Python, finding great mentors, and diving into one Linux project changed the way I think about software engineering. Overcoming burnout and discovering why real-world Linux tools matter.

item.title: Fixing a Dead Upstream URL in OpenPrinting: A Small but Important Contribution
item.dc:creator: Ayush Singh
item.description: Open-source maintenance often means fixing things that users never notice but depend on every day. A merged pull request tracking broken metadata in driver repositories to keep legacy hardware printing smoothly.

item.title: My Pull Request to OpenPrinting Got Merged: Fixing SpliX Driver Metadata
item.dc:creator: Ayush Singh
item.description: Open source is not only about writing new code. Sometimes, fixing small but critical details makes a big impact. Updating upstream metadata to ensure Samsung and Xerox laser printers match the correct drivers.

item.title: My First Merged Pull Request: Regenerating Printer Data from Foomatic-DB
item.dc:creator: Ayush Singh
item.description: How I used foomatic-db to generate complete static printer data and learned from open-source reviews. What it takes to land your very first contribution in an established Linux Foundation project.
